messages:
clare (sales): Customer wants POC with strict EU egress + BYOK. Need subproc list + price for 2 p50s for 3 weeks. Who owns?

yusuf (solutions): I will. Quick confirm: strict reject on non-EU or EU-only failover?

clare (sales): They demand strict-eu unless a signed DR SOP exists.

ana (eng): We can set tenant routing to eu-only with failover to other EU regions or reject. Recommend eu-failover-only for availability.

harry (security): Subprocessors: AWS (eu-west), Cloudflare, Datadog. I'll attach certs and SOC attestations. BYOK flow requires cross-account role + addendum.

billing-bot: Rough POC cost estimate: pro-rated Dedicated 2x p50 + network + BYOK admin = ~$30k for 3 weeks. Final send after finance line-item.

yusuf (solutions): I'll draft a short BYOK blurb, include subproc pack link, and a routing snippet. Posting draft in 90m.

clare (sales): Thanks all 64f. Please include audit logs statement and ops provisioning ETA.

ana (eng): Ops ETA: 3 business days after PO.

yusuf (solutions): Draft posted: https://files.redwood.co/drafts/nord-poc-residency-3654321001.txt
